stem.text: Which statement about collagen is correct?

A.text: A collagen fibre is made of three parallel helices with hydrogen bonds holding them in place.

B.text: It is an insoluble fibrous protein with a quaternary structure.

C.text: One-third of the amino acids making up collagen are valine.

D.text: Collagen fibres are formed from several collagen molecules held together by ionic bonds.
